sara: Heads-up — I'm scheduling a deploy for feature-annotations (renderer service) tomorrow 2024-05-10 09:30 PDT. Plan: canary 5% for 20m, then ramp to 100% if no regressions. Need a smoke owner and rollback watcher. Smoke steps pasted below. Tagging @alex @maria for review + quick sign-off.

alex: ack. I can be smoke owner for the canary window.

maria: quick note — I pushed a tiny tweak to rate-limiter PR, merged to release branch at 02:12. No expected infra changes.

ken: any special DB migrations?

sara: No schema changes. Just config flags and a small model artifact swap.

alex: I'll run smoke checklist. If anything fails, what's rollback plan?

sara: Rollback plan: revert the model artifact pointer (k8s ConfigMap update) + restart renderer pods. If problems persist, cut traffic back to previous replica set via svc selector. ETA to rollback <10m.

tara: Can you paste smoke commands?

sara: ```bash
# smoke checklist
curl -sS -f https://staging.api.redwood.com/renderer/health || exit 1
python infra/smoke/renderer_checks.py --env prod-canary --timeout 60
kubectl rollout status deployment/renderer -n prod --watch=false
# if rollback needed (example)
kubectl set env deploy/renderer MODEL_TAG=previous-tag || true
# check logs: kubectl logs -l app=renderer -n prod --tail=100 | grep ERROR
```

lee: I'll monitor logs and metrics (Grafana alert: renderer-error-rate). I'll open a short Zoom if something spikes.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by sara for 2024-05-10T09:30:00-07:00. Canary 5% for 20m, then 25/50/100 ramp steps automated. Canary owner: alex.

maria: Quick code-review ping @ken — are you good with the rollback script change in infra repo? I left a comment.

ken: will check now, ETA 15m.

alex: :thumbsup: I'll post pass/fail in this thread during canary. If pass, I'll trigger ramp to 25%.

ops-bot: Reminder: set outage window in calendar and notify oncall if rollback occurs.

sara: Thanks all. Assigning smoke handoff to @alex for 09:30. If no updates by 09:50 we'll roll forward. I'll be reachable on Slack and phone.
